title: Catchment rainfall, CHIRPS v3.0 monthly
description:
Monthly rainfall totals over the Ait Bouguemez valley catchment (geo_ait_bouguemez_catchment revision 1) from CHIRPS v3.0 final, 2019-01 to 2025-12, on its native 0.05 degree grid: 33 cells touch the catchment, 2 lie fully inside, fractions sum to 15.86 cells. Each Item gives the area-weighted catchment total and its departure from the 1991 to 2020 mean of the same calendar month, in mm, with every cell's value in cell-values.json.

A grid cell is not a rain gauge; values are not compared with any station here. Item geometries are the catchment simplified to one DEM pixel (1/3600 degree); the exact frozen geometry is the analysis_geometry asset.

providers.name: Climate Hazards Center, UC Santa Barbara
Siterra science pipeline
providers.processing:lineage: Range reads of one full-resolution tile per monthly CHIRPS v3.0 final global COG; native cells intersecting the frozen catchment weighted by area inside it (EPSG:32629); catchment totals; 1991-2020 same-month means; departures (docs/reference/observation-preprocessing.md section 5).

rainfall_cells.title: Native CHIRPS 0.05 degree cells touching the catchment, with fraction inside, weight and 1991-2020 monthly means

siterra:dataset.resolution_note: Native 0.05 degree grid, about 4.7 km east to west by 5.5 km north to south here

siterra:geo_selection.area_method: Planar area of the frozen polygon in EPSG:32629 (UTM 29N)

parameters.cell_selection: every native cell whose square intersects the analysis geometry
parameters.weight: cell area inside the geometry / geometry area, planar EPSG:32629
parameters.nodata: -9999 or negative values are missing; a month with any missing touched cell has no total

operation_order: read the window of each monthly final COG (one tile per month by HTTP range)
select native cells intersecting the frozen geometry and compute their area weights in EPSG:32629
compute the area-weighted catchment total per month
compute the 1991 to 2020 mean of catchment totals for each calendar month, requiring all 30 years
subtract the same-month mean to get the departure in mm

siterra:limitations: Rainfall is shown on its native 0.05 degree grid: 33 cells touch the catchment and 2 lie fully inside. A cell value is an estimate for the whole cell, not a gauge reading.
No rain gauge in or near the valley was compared with these values.
CHIRPS v3.0 fills missing satellite data with ERA5 and adjusts stations for gauge undercatch, so it is overall wetter than v2.0; never splice v2 and v3.
The 1991 to 2020 mean is a reference for departures, not a drought index; no SPI or percent of normal is computed.
Snowfall and snowmelt timing are not represented by a monthly precipitation total.

siterra:checks.name: recompute_sample_period
siterra:checks.detail: period_2022-04 recomputed from the separate CHIRPS v3.0 Africa GeoTIFF (https://data.chc.ucsb.edu/products/CHIRPS/v3.0/monthly/africa/tifs/chirps-v3.0.2022.04.tif) read by GDAL 3.12.2: 29.4776 mm vs pipeline value 29.4776 mm (stored 29.48 mm), difference 0.000000 mm, tolerance 0.01 mm

siterra:checks.name: nodata_not_zero
siterra:checks.detail: No-data (-9999) and negative values are treated as missing, never zero. Touched cells with no value across 1991-01 to 2025-12: 0

siterra:checks.name: units_and_scale
siterra:checks.detail: Values are float32 mm per month with no scale or offset. The COGs carry no unit tag; the official monthly NetCDF of the same product declares units = mm/month on precip (header read 2026-10-27)

siterra:checks.name: period_alignment
siterra:checks.detail: Each Item's period ID matches the file month in its source URL; STAC bounds run from the first to the last second of the month; final products only (no /prelim/ path)

siterra:checks.name: attribution_present
siterra:checks.detail: CHIRPS DOI and access date, and the Copernicus DEM notice for the geometry, are in siterra:attribution

siterra:checks.name: visual_inspection_sample
siterra:checks.detail: Cells, cell values, fractions and the catchment outline rendered for period_2022-04 and period_2023-03 and inspected by the science lane on 2026-10-27: the outline lies inside the union of touched cells, interior cells have fractions 0.997 to 1.000, values vary smoothly between neighbours, and in period_2023-03 the southern lobe cells (58 to 81 mm) were wetter than the main valley cells (29 to 45 mm)
